title: DBT Azure Config
description: DBT Catalog, Manifest and Run Results files in Azure bucket. We will search for catalog.json, manifest.json and run_results.json.

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: Your Service Principal App ID (Client ID)

tenantId.title: Tenant ID
tenantId.description: Tenant ID of your Azure Subscription

accountName.title: Storage Account Name
accountName.description: Account Name of your storage account

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: Scopes to get access token, for e.g. api://6dfX33ab-XXXX-49df-XXXX-3459eX817d3e/.default

endpointSuffix.title: Endpoint Suffix
endpointSuffix.description: DNS suffix for Azure Storage endpoints. Use 'core.windows.net' for Azure Commercial (default), 'core.usgovcloudapi.net' for Azure US Government, 'core.chinacloudapi.cn' for Azure China, or a custom sovereign/private DNS suffix.

authority.title: Authority Host
authority.description: Optional Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) authority host override (for example, 'https://login.microsoftonline.us' for Azure US Government or 'https://login.chinacloudapi.cn' for Azure China). Automatically inferred from endpointSuffix when omitted.

dbtPrefixConfig.title: DBT Prefix Config
dbtPrefixConfig.description: Details of the bucket where the dbt files are stored

dbtBucketName.title: DBT Bucket Name
dbtBucketName.description: Name of the bucket where the dbt files are stored

dbtObjectPrefix.title: DBT Object Prefix
dbtObjectPrefix.description: Path of the folder where the dbt files are stored
